title: Exact rigid 4D N=2 Wess-Fayet hypermultiplet with one off-shell central charge

sources.role: component transformations, closure, central symmetry, and 0-brane matrices
independent superspace account of the Fayet-Sohnius hypermultiplet with complex central charge

report.boundary: This certifies the free rigid real-central-charge Wess-Fayet component system and its exact CC worldline bridge. It does not certify an interacting hypermultiplet, a gauged central charge, a general complex central charge, or a central-charge-free finite hypermultiplet.
